desc:
Zombie survival tycoon: build a camp by day, defend it from hordes and giant bosses by night, then launch the rocket and rebirth. Up to 8 camps per server!

NOW: HARVEST FEAST until Dec 1 - Grandma Crumble, the Gobbler boss and pie rewards at the Feast Stall.

- Claim a camp: generators, walls, gates, turrets, guards and a four-floor HQ
- Survive 10-minute day-night cycles with Special Nights, six camp bosses and the server-wide Colossus
- Recruit troops, drive vehicles, fly an attack helicopter and hold outposts with your team
- Rescue survivors, run a farm and research upgrades that last through rebirth
- Raid Bunker 9, a 1-4 player dungeon with a boss at the end
- Nightmare Mode: tougher 4-player servers with Nightmare bosses
- PvP is optional. Play solo or team up (teams of up to 4)

Rebirth for permanent bonuses, unlock new base gear and see how far your camp can last.
